title: QuadricepsReplicationPackage.jl: replication package for 'Positive weight Hermite and Legendre quadrature rules'
description: Julia package that holds every positive-weight quadrature rule of the paper's two tables (Gaussian weight N(0, I_d) and uniform weight on [0,1]^d, d = 2,...,5) in double precision and rebuilds the tables from them: node counts, the quality measure rho, Moeller's lower bound, and the largest relative error over all monomials of total degree at most p in 192-bit arithmetic.
